method: bounded read-only /sbin/iw reg get and /sbin/iw phy phy0 info on authenticated Gemian
tool: iw 4.9-0.1 already installed at /sbin/iw; no package installation
global_5ghz_ranges: passive scan in 5170-5250 and 5735-5835 MHz; DFS and passive scan in 5250-5330 and 5490-5730 MHz
limitations: One Gemian reference snapshot. The global regulatory ranges and driver-reported per-channel power are separate outputs; this does not establish actual transmit permissions or mainline firmware policy. No radio control or package change was made.
